paired_dataset_scope: 61 unmodified single-RNA sequences, strict canonical geometry annotation and masked labels; 49/6/6 samples across 7/4/4 groups
screened_release_policy: Exact-sequence deduplicated, evidence-screened pools; measured probing is not pair truth. Require joint homology/study/construct split before training. Existing paired_v0_2 remains the small pipeline-validation default.
intended_use: Small pipeline validation only; expand data and annotation validation before scientific architecture comparison

comparative_auxiliary_policy.status: separate auxiliary pool; not gold and not automatically approved
comparative_auxiliary_policy.purpose: Optional representation learning or auxiliary pairing supervision, evaluated by ablation on held-out direct experiments
required: explicit exclusion of predicted validation records
prohibited: promoting all comparative records solely based on database name
mixing gold and auxiliary labels without provenance
training or tuning on experimental test homologs

excluded_from_pair_truth: RNAfold and other thermodynamic model predictions
AI model predictions including high-confidence predictions
comparative sequence labels without direct per-molecule experimental support
SHAPE/DMS reactivity converted into a presumed unique pairing diagram
probing_policy: Retain original measured positions only. Never fill NaNs or use model-imputed positions as measured truth.
sequence_policy: Biological or designed-and-measured sequences must retain provenance; one-dimensional sequence data do not imply experimental two-dimensional labels.
quality_policy: Resolution filters are preliminary. Require residue coverage, annotation provenance and chain/context checks before gold admission. NMR requires separate restraint/ensemble review.
archive_policy: Preserve raw and legacy benchmark files; exclusion means do not use as approved training data, not destructive deletion.
